Site Reliability Engineer (G-project)
Locations: Houston (IB3)   
Business Units: CESBG   
Job Classification: Exempt   

Summary

We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Site Reliability Engineer to join our IT team. This role is crucial for ensuring that software systems and applications are reliable, scalable, and efficient by combining software engineering with operations and automation. Bridge the gap between development and operations by applying software engineering principles to operational tasks, automating processes and monitoring systems to prevent failures.

             Key Responsibilities:
 
Responsible for supporting production
Design systems and processes and support implementation 
User training and system issue tracking 
Learn about MES and manufacturing production 
Design control systems to minimize and resolve production issues and project costs.
Develop standards for production and design by customizing MES tool per business needs 
Administer and assist production related applications 
               Skills 
Must be action/results oriented, hands-on, self-motivated, detail oriented and organized with the ability to quickly learn processes, procedures and software necessary to manage projects 
Ability to work effectively under pressure, and flexibility to adapt to fast pace environment and tight schedules 
Critical thinking skills with strong business acumen and consideration. 
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills both verbal and written for sharing ideas with other departments and the customer 
Skill to communicate ideas and instructions clearly and concisely – written and verbal 
Proficient computer skills utilizing Office 365: Word, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, Project, PowerPoint 
            Qualifications Education & Experience:
Associate’s or higher degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience 
Minimum of 0-3 years’ relevant experience 
Experience in Python desired 
Knowledge of the application of tools/techniques 
Experience in one coding language (Preferred) 
Experience in Database (Preferred) 
             Why Join Us
Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage.
Basic life insurance and short-term disability coverage provided by employer.
Supplemental life insurance and long-term disability coverage options available.
401K with employer contribution.
Personal, Vacation, and Holiday paid time off for all full-time employees.

Our company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). All qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or marital status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.
